evidence.summary: 5-angle capture vs cottage references: roof panels slope upward/outward in a V (butterfly) instead of an A gable, floating off the walls with open gaps and exposed gable wedges.

reasons: Roof inverted: slopes rise from a low central ridge outward, opposite of the gabled roof in references and brief
Roof not seated on walls - visible air gap/black wedge between wall tops and roof underside on front and gable ends
Gable WedgeParts protrude exposed above wall corners, breaking the silhouette
Chimney, stone walls, trimmed windows, green door and porch are present but the building does not read as a coherent house from front/left/right

config.style: single-storey fieldstone cottage, dark slate gabled roof, massive external gable-end chimney, white-trimmed windows, green plank door under a shed porch

steps: get_references('stone cottage house') - noted signature features: stone walls, dark pitched roof, white window trim, prominent external chimney, porch over entry

checked ServerStorage.FactoryStaging prior structure_house variants (timber-jetty, brick+plaster, segmented kits) and chose a distinct concept: fieldstone cottage with external gable-end chimney stack + shed porch

assembled 54-part Model at (150,150) on open ground: floor slab, pierced stone walls (Slate), wedge gables, two overhanging roof planes + ridge cap, 3-stage tapered stone chimney, framed door (4x7 opening) with slab+knob, 3 white-trimmed glass windows with mullions, shed porch roof on posts + step
capture pipeline down (CaptureService no screenshot after repeated retries) - verified geometrically instead: doorway raycast clear-through, 7-stud door clearance, bbox 29.5x20.8x22

recipe.text: Fieldstone cottage distinct from prior staged houses (those were timber-jetty/brick-plaster/kit-ring variants). Built entirely from anchored primitives: Slate stone walls in 3 tones, wall openings framed by sill/head parts (no CSG), WedgePart gables, rotated slab roof planes with 1-stud eave overhang, external 3-stage chimney rising past the ridge per reference photos. Door opening 4x7 studs verified by raycast; windows are Glass panes with SmoothPlastic white trim + center mullion. Vision sidecar captures failed all attempts, so visual pass is deferred to VERIFY; geometry validated by bounding-box + raycast probes.
